tools.name: odei_connect_handshake
tools.description: Verify an app.odei.ai pairing code and open an ODEI Connect session.

pairing_code.description: Fresh ODEI pairing code from app.odei.ai/profile.

tools.name: odei_connect_status
tools.description: Return current ODEI Connect ceremony progress.

tools.name: odei_connect_plan
tools.description: Return the ordered local ODEI install plan and reporting contract.

tools.name: odei_connect_report_step
tools.description: Record evidence that a Connect ceremony step has completed.

tools.name: odei_connect_talk
tools.description: Answer from ODEI Connect session state without invoking a model API.

tools.name: wm_remember
tools.description: Write one fact to your operator memory in ODEI — the World Model grows from it. Server-side (ODEI-hosted) memory for the paired operator; not the local world-model capsule.

kind.description: Optional kind tag, e.g. preference, project, person. Defaults to note.

tools.name: wm_recall
tools.description: Read facts back from your ODEI-hosted operator memory. Simple substring + recency match (v1) — no semantic search yet.

query.description: Optional substring filter over fact text and kind.
